About us

From the classroom to real engineering

We are Emirati engineering students at the Higher Colleges of Technology, turning what we learn into practical engineering experience.

Our goal is to contribute to the UAE's progress in research, innovation and emerging technology. The KR8.063 Nanodrone project builds the skills and technical capability that the nation's technological future depends on.

We develop and test on the Crazyflie 2.x research platform while we design and build our own custom nano drone.

Modular development

Platforms, sensors and technologies are tested, combined and expanded step by step as the research progresses.

Research-driven design

Engineering decisions rest on technical studies, academic literature and continuous evaluation.

Multidisciplinary engineering

Mechanical, hardware, software and AI teams build one integrated indoor nanodrone platform together.

Open-source innovation

Open-source tools speed up prototyping, so the team can focus on system integration, algorithms and autonomy.

The drone is launched at the doorway and enters the building before anyone else.

Senses every wall

What we build

Three divisions, one platform

Mechanical Engineering

Mechanical Design

Airframe studies, 3D-printed in different materials and designs. Structural analysis, mounting, weight and centre-of-gravity optimisation.

Electrical Engineering

Hardware & Electronics

Sensors, motors, power and flight-control integration. Wiring, embedded hardware and validation.

Electrical Engineering

Software & AI

Live person detection, flight software, computer vision and mission algorithms. Autonomy is in development.

    The technology behind our Nanodrone

    01

    Nano drone R&D platform

    We program Crazyflie 2.x, select and integrate sensors, and develop and test flight, software, AI, and sensing functions.

    Custom nano drone architecture

    We design, build, and integrate the custom Nano Drone, including the airframe, propulsion, power, electronics, sensors, and flight-control system.

    • Sensors, motors, power and flight-control integration
    • Indoor flight testing
